name: Notionsify – 2D & 3D Product Configurator for WooCommerce
author: Notionsify

sections.description:
Make Every Product Personal with Interactive 2D, 3D & AR Experiences.

With Notionsify’s 2D and 3D Product Customizer plugin, turn your WooCommerce store into an interactive shopping experience. Let customers design unique products by personalizing colours, text, materials, fonts, and uploading their own photos.

With AR and Virtual Try-On, you can take online shopping to the next level by allowing customers to visualize products in real time before making a purchase.

Built for growing WooCommerce businesses: simplify the shopping experience, increase conversions, and streamline order fulfillment.

No coding or theme modifications required. Simply install the Notionsify 2D and 3D Product Customizer plugin and connect it to your WooCommerce store. The plugin seamlessly manages storefront customization options, cart and order data, and the integration between your WooCommerce store and Notionsify account.

What You’ll Get

  • Unlimited Product Customization Options: Give customers the freedom to personalize products with text, colours, pricing, templates, and uploaded photos.
  • 2D & 3D Product Configurator: Connect powerful product customization and visualization tools directly to your WooCommerce store.
  • AR & Virtual Try-On: Let customers experience realistic product previews before purchasing.
  • Cloud-Based Asset Storage: Store and manage product assets securely, with access anytime and anywhere.
  • Print-Ready Files: Carry customized product designs through the cart, checkout, and order fulfillment process.
  • Easy Installation & Integration: Enjoy a one-click installation and plug-and-play setup designed to work with your WordPress theme.

Interactive 3D Product Customizer

Let customers bring their ideas to life with an interactive 3D product customization experience. Allow shoppers to personalize products in real time by changing colours, materials, textures, designs, and other product elements while viewing their selections in 3D.

Give your customers a realistic preview of their customized products from every angle, helping them make confident purchasing decisions and creating a more engaging shopping experience.

Key Benefits:

  • Interactive 360° 3D product visualization.
  • Real-time customization and previews.
  • Customize colours, materials, textures, and components.
  • Create engaging and immersive shopping experiences.
  • Help customers visualize products before purchasing.

2D Visual Product Customizer

Turn ordinary product pages into interactive customization experiences with a powerful 2D visual product customizer. Let customers personalize products by adding text, images, logos, patterns, colours, and other design elements directly onto the product preview.

Whether it’s apparel, promotional merchandise, gifts, or personalized accessories, customers can see their designs come together visually before placing an order.

Key Benefits:

  • Real-time 2D product previews.
  • Add custom text, images, and logos.
  • Change colours and design elements.
  • Personalize products with an easy-to-use editor.
  • Give customers more control over their purchases.

Immersive AR and Virtual Try-On

Bring products closer to customers with Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Try-On technology. Allow shoppers to visualize products in their own environment or see how selected items look on them before making a purchase.

From eyewear and accessories to furniture, home décor, and lifestyle products, AR experiences help bridge the gap between online shopping and real-world product experiences.

Make shopping more interactive, improve product confidence, and help customers make informed buying decisions.

Key Benefits:

  • Immersive Augmented Reality experiences.
  • Virtual product try-on and visualization.
  • Preview products in real-world environments.
  • Improve customer engagement and confidence.
  • Create more interactive online shopping experiences.

Efficient Product Asset Management

Manage all your product visuals and customization resources in one organized place. Product Asset Management makes it easier to organize, access, and manage the digital assets needed to create engaging product customization experiences.

Keep your product images, textures, designs, patterns, materials, and other visual resources organized to simplify your workflow and maintain consistency across your product catalog.

Key Benefits:

  • Centralized product asset organization.
  • Manage product images and visual resources.
  • Organize textures, patterns, and materials.
  • Simplify product customization workflows.
  • Maintain consistent product visuals across your store.

Who Is It For?

Notionsify is built for businesses that want to offer more interactive, personalized, and engaging online shopping experiences.

Whether you sell customizable products, personalized gifts, fashion items, or furniture, our product visualization and customization solutions help you give customers more control over what they buy.

Perfect For:

  • WooCommerce Store Owners: Enhance your online store with interactive product customization and visualization.
  • Print-on-Demand Businesses: Let customers personalize apparel, merchandise, accessories, and promotional products.
  • Fashion and Apparel Brands: Offer virtual try-on experiences and personalized clothing designs.
  • Furniture and Home Décor Stores: Help customers visualize products, colours, and materials in their spaces.
  • Personalized Gift Shops: Allow shoppers to create unique gifts with custom text, images, and designs.
  • Manufacturers and Product Brands: Showcase product variations and customization possibilities through interactive 2D and 3D experiences.
  • E-commerce Agencies and Developers: Build advanced product customization experiences for WooCommerce clients.

External service

This plugin is a client for Notionsify, a paid third-party service operated by Hummingbird International, LLC. The plugin will not function without a Notionsify account, and a free trial is available.

The plugin communicates with https://notionsify.com in the following cases:

  • When you connect your store, it sends your store URL and the WooCommerce API credentials you approve, so your store can be linked to your Notionsify account.
  • On a product page, it asks whether a configurator is linked to that product, sending the WooCommerce product ID and your store URL.
  • When an order is placed, WooCommerce sends the order to Notionsify so the configured item can be produced.

No data is sent before you connect your store.

Terms and Privacy

Our services are covered by these terms:

  • Terms of Service: https://notionsify.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://notionsify.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Notionsify in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Click Connect Notionsify. You are taken to your Notionsify dashboard and returned to WordPress.
  4. WooCommerce asks you to approve API access. Click Approve.
  5. Open your Notionsify dashboard and link a configurator to a WooCommerce product.

Your site must be served over HTTPS. WooCommerce requires it for the authorization step.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Notionsify account?

Yes. The plugin connects your store to the Notionsify service, where configurators are built and orders are processed. A free trial is available.

How does connecting work?

Through the standard WooCommerce Auth Endpoint. You approve API access inside your own WordPress admin, and the keys are generated by WooCommerce rather than pasted by hand.

Where do customer customizations end up?

On the order line item. You see them in the order details in WooCommerce, and can download print-ready files from your Notionsify dashboard.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The configurator button is added through standard WooCommerce hooks, so no template files are edited.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin declares HPOS compatibility and writes order data through the WooCommerce CRUD API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • The storefront now explains why the Customize button is missing — not connected, product not linked, or the backend unreachable — instead of failing silently.
  • The standard Add to Cart button is hidden reliably on themes that do not render it inside form.cart, including block themes.

1.0.1

  • Hardened the WooCommerce authorization callback: cryptographically secure one-time secret, constant-time verification, and a 15-minute expiry.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
